models.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: targeted correction to existing native pixel-art car sprite in the Poketurismo catalog.
Input images: IMAGE 1 is the EDIT TARGET, current approved-style GREEN pixel sprite. IMAGE 2 is the USER ORIGINAL photograph for identity and stock trim. Remaining photographs are REAL ANATOMY references for the requested correction only; do not transfer their colour, extra doors, modifications, backgrounds, stickers or wheels.
Requested correction: Correct Alfa Romeo 75 Quadrifoglio FOUR-DOOR. Restore its distinctive thick DARK CHARCOAL/BLACK BELT-LINE STRIP running the FULL SIDE just below side-window sill from front wing through both doors to rear quarter, rising in a sharp dogleg on the C-pillar/rear quarter and wrapping across the boot trailing edge, as real photo. The strip is unpainted trim, NEVER green and NEVER recoloured. It is separate from black bumper rub strips. Redesign rear silhouette from authentic photo: angular wedge saloon with sharply slanted rear glass, short high horizontal boot deck, clipped vertical tail, integrated black trailing trim and low broad red/amber rear corner lamp band, not generic 155 tail. Keep original front, four doors, period silver wheels and no racing wing.
Preserve invariants aggressively: same vehicle identity, same camera FRONT-LEFT three-quarter view, nose pointing DOWN-LEFT, about 40% front and 60% side. Full isolated car, straight wheels, clean transparent margins and genuinely transparent background. Preserve all unrelated front/body/wheel details of image 1; change the specified anatomy/material only. Do not turn the whole car to rear view: only show naturally visible rear corner, never invent a tall taillight to fill a hidden area.
Keep EXACT same authentic hand-built logical 320x128 pixel-art style: sharp square clusters, clean one-pixel outlines, dark panel gaps, compact six-shade blocks, NO smooth render, antialiasing, photography filter, vector curves, soft gradients, blur or dithering/noisy stipple. Wide approximately 3:1 canvas. Do not squeeze or stretch the body.
RECOLOUR CONTRACT: every PAINTED panel, bumper, mirror, skirt, edge and highlight uses distinctly SATURATED GREEN ramp only #103b24 #196137 #2f8a46 #4dac5a #80c773 #b4e89c. G at least20 higher than R and B on paint highlights; no neutral grey or white speckles on paint. All genuine black trim stays charcoal/black, including explicitly requested Alfa75 belt-line. Glass dark steel blue/cool grey, tyres black, wheels silver except Williams GOLD, headlamps ivory, rear lamps red/amber. No green in nonpaint details.
No text, caption, watermark, scenery, road, person, extra car, new accessory or modern modification. Preserve transparency. Single complete corrected car sprite.
